tree.heading: Fund
tree.text: The term “Fund” means the Collaborative Forest Landscape Restoration Fund established by section 7303(f) of this title.

tree.heading: Program
tree.text: The term “program” means the Collaborative Forest Landscape Restoration Program established under section 7303(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Proposal
tree.text: The term “proposal” means a collaborative forest landscape restoration proposal described in section 7303(b) of this title.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Agriculture, acting through the Chief of the Forest Service.

tree.heading: Strategy
tree.text: The term “strategy” means a landscape restoration strategy described in section 7303(b)(1) of this title.
